descriptors.definition: Indian Accounting Standard 1 prescribes the overall structural requirements, minimum disclosures, and general features for general-purpose financial statements. Its mandates ensure consistency across primary financial components like the balance sheet and statement of profit and loss.
inclusion: Consolidated financial statements
Separate financial statements
exclusion: Structure and content of condensed interim financial statements under Ind AS 34
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from specific recognition and measurement standards which supplement presentation rules.

descriptors.definition: The objective establishes a standardized basis for presenting general-purpose financial statements to facilitate comparability with an entity's historical reports and those of external entities. It mandates comprehensive structural rules and baseline content specifications.
inclusion: Historical financial statement comparisons
Cross-entity financial comparisons
exclusion: Tailored custom reports for individual users
nearby_distinctions: Differs from recognition criteria by focusing exclusively on presentation formatting and comparability.

descriptors.definition: The standard governs all entities publishing general-purpose financial reports, including consolidated and separate financial formats. Profit-oriented terminology applies, requiring adaptation for non-profit or non-equity organizational structures.
inclusion: Public sector business entities
Profit-oriented commercial entities
exclusion: Condensed interim financial statements structure under Ind AS 34, except paragraphs 15 to 35
nearby_distinctions: Excludes interim reporting frameworks while encompassing annual consolidated and separate statements.

descriptors.definition: Information is considered material if its omission, misstatement, or obscuring could reasonably influence primary user decisions. Entities must assess materiality based on the nature or magnitude of items within the context of complete financial statements.
inclusion: Assessment of qualitative and quantitative materiality factors
Identification of obscured disclosures
exclusion: Immaterial disclosures not required by law
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between transparent immaterial aggregation and harmful obscuring of material facts.

descriptors.definition: Financial statements supply structured data regarding an entity's financial position, performance, and cash flows to assist users in economic decision-making. They detail assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses, and owner contributions to project future cash flows.
inclusion: Assets, liabilities, and equity balances
Income, expenses, and cash flow metrics
exclusion: Management financial reviews or environmental reports published outside financial statements
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes core financial statements from supplementary annual report reviews.

descriptors.definition: A comprehensive set requires a balance sheet, statement of profit and loss, changes in equity, cash flows, and explanatory notes with material policies. Equal prominence must be given to all statements, incorporating appropriate comparative periods.
inclusion: Opening balance sheet for retrospective accounting changes
Two-section statement of profit and loss and OCI
exclusion: External reports like management commentary or value-added statements
nearby_distinctions: Differentiates routine annual comparative data from retroactive opening balance sheet requirements.

descriptors.concept_name: True and Fair View and Compliance
descriptors.definition: Financial statements must faithfully represent operational transactions and events in accordance with Conceptual Framework definitions. Compliance with applicable Indian Accounting Standards creates a legal presumption of achieving a true and fair view.
inclusion: Explicit compliance notes in financial statements
Additional disclosures when standard requirements prove insufficient
exclusion: Unverified compliance claims lacking adherence to complete standard criteria
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes baseline standard compliance from supplemental disclosures needed for genuine clarity.

descriptors.concept_name: Presentation of True and Fair View and Compliance with Ind AS
descriptors.definition: Financial statements must faithfully represent operational transactions and events in accordance with Conceptual Framework definitions. Compliance with applicable Indian Accounting Standards creates a legal presumption of achieving a true and fair view.
inclusion: Explicit compliance notes in financial statements
Additional disclosures when standard requirements prove insufficient
exclusion: Unverified compliance claims lacking adherence to complete standard criteria
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes baseline standard compliance from supplemental disclosures needed for genuine clarity.

descriptors.definition: Entities must prepare financial statements on a going concern basis unless management intends liquidation or cessation of trading. Management must evaluate viability for a minimum of twelve months following the reporting period end.
inclusion: Evaluation of financing terms and cash flow forecasts
Identification of net liability positions or default risks
exclusion: Continuation of going concern assumption when liquidation intent is confirmed
nearby_distinctions: Separates short-term working capital fluctuations from terminal operational cessation indicators.

descriptors.concept_name: Accrual Basis of Accounting and Materiality Aggregation
descriptors.definition: Financial statements, excluding cash flow data, must be prepared using the accrual basis to recognize elements when definition criteria are satisfied. Material classes must be presented separately while preventing the obscuring of critical information through poor aggregation.
inclusion: Separate presentation of material dissimilar items
Accrual recognition of income and expenses
exclusion: Cash flow statement preparation on an accrual basis
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes proper functional aggregation from improper obscuring via immaterial dilution.

descriptors.definition: Entities are required to present individual material classes separately while keeping dissimilar elements distinct unless explicitly permitted. Aggregation must not obscure primary understandability or lump dissimilar transactional natures together.
inclusion: Separate line-item presentation for material items
Consolidation of immaterial items into notes or summary lines
exclusion: Inappropriate combination of disparate functional categories
nearby_distinctions: Separates required granular disclosures from permitted summary grouping of immaterial items.

descriptors.definition: Offsetting assets against liabilities or income against expenses is prohibited unless explicitly required or permitted by an accounting standard. Measuring assets net of valuation allowances or reporting net gains from similar transactions does not constitute prohibited offsetting.
inclusion: Netting inventory obsolescence or doubtful debt allowances
Gains and losses on disposal of non-current assets
exclusion: Netting agency commissions or unrelated revenue and expense streams
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes permitted valuation adjustments from prohibited combination of distinct receivables and payables.
